_comment: Search keyword bank per form + language. primary = the exact phrase people type (goes first in the title, first line of the description and first tag). titles = A/B title templates; the biweekly review rotates to the next one when CTR is low. Placeholders: {primary} {year} {hook}. learned.json (written by seo-review) adds real search terms on top of this.
